### MKS Test `r if(params$show_years) glue("({params$start}-{params$end})")`

For more information, see [here](https://rileywheadon.github.io/ffa-framework/eda/#mann-kendall-sneyers-test). 

`r params$msg`

Additional information:

- Number of crossings: `r nrow(params$crossing_df)`
- Number of significant crossings: `r nrow(params$change_df)`
- Significance threshold: `r round(params$bound, 2)`
